title: Python ccp.py: adaptive_sf_select step-3 density threshold 10 -> 8 (spec 02a 2a.8)
description: python/src/lichen/ccp.py:231 adaptive_sf_select uses 'if density > 10 or utilization > 150' and the docstring at :197 says Density > 10. Spec 02a 2a.8 step 3 is Density > 8 (now also aligned in spec/02-physical-link.md:115 by bead g7p7); C (gradient.c, bead b7z9.30.1) and Rust (rf_health.rs DENSITY_HIGH=8, bead b7z9.30.3) already use 8; ccp16.json vector select_channel_density_high_ch0 (density=10 -> sf=11 via density>8) pins 8. Fix the code and docstring, then run the python ccp tests (pytest python/tests -k ccp) — check whether any python test pins 10 first. Worker1 spec bead g7p7 covered only the editorial spec fix.
